2. VICTIM "A" THROUGH P.S. DHANOURA,
 DISTRICT SEONI (MADHYA PRADESH)

(BY SHRI PRAMOD CHOUBEY - GOVT. ADVO  RESPONDENT/STATE)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.80/2023, registered at Police Station-Dhanoura, District Seoni (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 363, 376, 376(2)(i), 343, 506 of IPC and Section 4, 6 of POCSO Act, 2012.
2 . Learned counsel appearing for applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and falsely being implicated in the case.
Investigation in the case is complete and charge-sheet has already been filed.
In these circumstances, applicant be released on bail.
